chrome.signOutBody: You'll need to sign in again. Unsaved work in this session will be lost.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageDescription: The dashboard and API follow this culture. Product names fall back to English when a translation is missing.
settings.themeDescription: Pick a colour mode for the dashboard. System follows your OS.
settings.loadProfileFailed: Couldn't load your profile. Showing details from your session; saved changes may not reflect the latest server state.
settings.photoDesc: Shown in the topbar and on your activity. Square crops work best — JPG, PNG, or WebP.
settings.identityDesc: Your name and contact details, visible across the dashboard.
settings.emailHint: Contact your tenant admin to change your sign-in email.
settings.subjectIdDesc: The unique ID this account uses inside the platform. Read-only.
settings.activeSessionsDesc: Browsers and devices currently signed in to your account.
settings.noSessionsBody: Session activity will appear here once you sign in from any device.
settings.passwordDesc: Used to sign in to this tenant. Choose a strong, unique password.
settings.passwordHint: We recommend a passphrase of 16+ characters with no reuse from other services.
settings.changePasswordDesc: Pick a strong password you don't reuse elsewhere. Your other signed-in sessions stay active — revoke them below if you want them out.
settings.passwordChangedBody: Other active sessions remain valid until you revoke them.
settings.useAtLeast8: New password must be at least 8 characters.
settings.mustDiffer: New password must differ from the current one.
settings.twoFaDesc: Require a one-time code from an authenticator app on every sign-in.
settings.enrollHint: You'll scan a QR code in your authenticator app (1Password, Google Authenticator, Authy, …).
settings.twoFaEnabledBody: Future logins require a 6-digit code from your authenticator.
settings.codeMismatch: That code didn't match. Try again.
settings.twoFaDisableDesc: Two-factor is currently enabled. Confirm your password to disable — this rotates the authenticator secret, so a fresh enroll will generate a new QR code.
settings.notifDesc: Choose which events you want delivered as email or in-app notifications.
settings.notifPlaceholderBody: In-app notifications are already delivered to your bell — open it from the top bar to see them. Granular per-event email opt-ins are on the v1.1 roadmap. In the meantime, your tenant admin can disable email delivery globally.
settings.apiKeysDesc: Long-lived credentials used by services to call the FSH API. Treat them like passwords.
settings.apiKeysPlaceholderBody: Personal access tokens and service-to-service API keys are on the v1.1 roadmap. For now, your access flows through the user-bound JWT issued at sign-in. Track progress on the public roadmap or watch the next release notes.
settings.pasteHint: Direct link to an image you host elsewhere.
settings.noPublicUrl: Server returned no publicUrl for this file.

auth.inactivity: You were signed out due to inactivity.
auth.demoSignIn: Sign in with a demo account
auth.resetSubtitle: Enter the email you sign in with. We'll send a one-time link.
auth.inboxBodyAfter: , a one-time reset link is on its way. The link expires in 30 minutes.
auth.inboxTipSpam: Didn't get it? Wait a minute, then check spam.
auth.inboxTipRetry: Still nothing? Confirm the email + tenant and try again.
auth.passwordUpdatedBody: Sign in with your new password to continue.
auth.linkIncompleteBody: The reset link is missing one of token, email, or tenant. Some email clients clip long URLs — try copy-pasting the full link from the original email into your browser's address bar.
auth.verifyingBody: One moment — checking the confirmation token with the server.
auth.emailConfirmedDefault: Your email is confirmed. You can now sign in.
auth.confirmExpiredHint: The link may have expired or been used already. If you've signed in since this email was sent, you can ignore it.
auth.confirmMalformed: This confirmation link is missing required parameters. It may have been clipped by your email client.
auth.demoDescription: Pick a demo tenant and account to sign in with.
auth.demoHint: Explore fullstackhero as any user across the demo tenants — we'll sign you in instantly.
auth.inactivityBody: You've been inactive for a while. We'll sign you out shortly to keep your account secure.

shop.noStoresBody: Ask an operator to create a customer and store before ordering.
shop.needStore: Select a store to see contract prices and place orders.
shop.catalogDescription: Prices are quoted for the selected store. Catalog list prices are never shown here.
shop.cartDescription: Quoted prices follow the selected store's contract.
shop.ordersDescription: Reserved orders can be amended or cancelled before cutoff.
shop.emptyCartBody: Add products from the catalog to place an order.
shop.noProductsBody: The catalog is empty for this tenant.
shop.noOrdersBody: Place an order from the cart to see it here.
shop.amendNeedsLines: Keep at least one line, or cancel the order.
shop.confirmCancel: Cancel this order? Reserved stock will be released.
shop.beforeCutoff: You can amend or cancel until cutoff.
shop.afterCutoff: This order is locked. Changes are no longer allowed.
shop.noClaimsBody: Received orders can be claimed here after delivery.

ops.scanGuid: Scan an order id or tote id (GUID).
ops.shipmentsDescription: Build a route shipment, scan an order or tote onto the truck, depart, then capture POD with photos.
ops.noShipmentsBody: Create a shipment for packed orders on a route, then load it here.
ops.putawayDescription: Confirm inbound or return lots onto a same-zone storage or pick location.
ops.noPutawayBody: QC pass and on-truck returns create pending putaway tasks.
ops.purchaseDescription: Register a supplier, raise a draft PO, then send it so QC can receive.
ops.noPosYetBody: Create a supplier and a draft PO, then send it for QC.
ops.wavesDescription: Cutoff auto-builds draft waves by zone and route. Release FEFO, then pack.
ops.noWavesBody: Run cutoff to lock orders and draft waves, then release FEFO.
ops.qcDescription: Pass or fail inbound lines. Purchasing and QC are separate permissions.
ops.noPosBody: Inbound POs that are sent or receiving show up here for QC.
ops.picksDescription: Scan the allocated lot. A wrong lot is rejected.
ops.noPicksBody: Release a wave to allocate FEFO lots onto pick tasks.
